descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-06 tests 4-5 and Also confirm 2-3; TFA-94609 Spec 1 · “A baseline survey is shown once, before the physician adds their first patient”.

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S08 Existing chromium specs: a handoff sent from the screen with its follow-up, the two rounding timestamps, feedback from Settings, the baseline offered, answered once, and Not now

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Sending a handoff logs both the handoff generation and the send (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3)
  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored (UAT OAT-06 Test 4; TFA-94514 AC 3; TFA-94609 Spec 2; TFA-94609 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2; TFA-94514 AC 4; TFA-94609 AC 7)
  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3; TFA-94514 AC 5; TFA-94609 Spec 3)
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize … (UAT OAT-06 closing line; TFA-94514 AC 8; TFA-94609 AC 5; TFA-94609 AC 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium fixtures: the shared demo account (Hospital), and a brand-new physician with no patients signed in through the UI

When Send a two-patient handoff to OTHER_USER and answer Yes; open a note-ready chart and tap Mark Encounter Complete; rate 4 in Settings and send feedback; baseline: card visible -> Start survey -> answer all five -> Submit -> reload; a second account: Not now -> reload

Then handoff_sent with patientCount >= 2 and no patient text, follow-up dialog with the exact question and a handoff_followup 'yes' row; pre_round_summary_opened then note_marked_complete (hospital) with numeric minutes; a feedback row with rating 4 and the comment; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Hospital only; the handoff spec does not check the handoff_generated row (S07) and none of them checks the rollup. The baseline account has no patients, so this is the 'before the first patient' case only; the with-patients, shared-browser and later-day cases are S13, and what 'Not now' should do on the next days is T5 / Q1 (S14)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
